What does one AI question actually cost?
Welcome to Agent School — lesson twenty-three.
Apps like ChatGPT are the shop window.
Builders use the API — the back door your code talks to.
An API call is a small message: which model, a system prompt, your question.
A few lines of code — and the answer comes back as text.
A short question to a small model often costs less than a tenth of a cent.
But a big model, a long document, and an agent that calls it a hundred times… that adds up fast.
So every builder learns to read the bill: tokens in, tokens out, times price, times calls.
Remember: cost equals tokens times price times how many calls.
